$comment: Source of truth for the Coral Ensemble presets. Edit this file and run 'make presets' to regenerate plugins/CoralEnsemble/Presets.hpp (DPF programs, exported to LV2 presets.ttl/manifest.ttl and to VST3/CLAP). The parameter order below must match the Parameters enum in DistrhoPluginInfo.h (rate, depth, mix, model); program 0 must equal 'defaults'.

presets.name: Smiths clean shimmer (Marr-style, rate 10-11, depth 1-2)
presets.source: fan recreations of the Smiths chorus: rate 10-11 o'clock, depth 1-2 o'clock (guitargangsters; community). A recreation, not Johnny Marr's published settings

presets.name: TSOL / SoCal death rock (rate 9 o'clock, depth near noon)
presets.source: BOSS article: rate set to a crawl at 9 o'clock and the depth just shy of noon

presets.name: Max warp, both knobs full (gentle warbling vibrato)
presets.source: Guitar World: even with the rate and depth knobs fully maxed, it produces a gently warbling vibrato

presets.name: Bass: low end preserved (CE-2B)
presets.source: illustrative CE-2B setting; Aion describes its mix control as especially useful for bass guitar so the low-end is preserved
